change_summary: Register provider-free challenger, chronology, distribution and publication regressions. Forecast records require parent-card and source receipt digests. No baseline, ledger or production-runner modification. Add separate public historical schedule/team-box reconstruction using native factorial comparator and read-only historical CI; no live runner changes. Fit residual family parameters once on 2019–22 reconstructed baseline forecasts; score fixed 2023–25 holdout and retain per-event probabilities, reliability and diagnostic total threshold outcomes. Explicit RUN IT private source contract, receipt-byte verification and parent native parity; optional --factorial-sidecar path, disabled by default. Register fixed-train pace/efficiency/HCA and full-game diagnostic calibration on common model-derived thresholds; retain separate research outputs.
assumptions: Synthetic regression success is not evidence of predictive improvement or source authenticity.
The sidecar collector fails closed until ratings and prior-game filenames are exactly contracted.
Daily live execution remains main-only; this branch cannot collect production forecasts before a reviewed merge.
No completed external acceptance of the latest repair is asserted.
Public reconstructed raw per-possession ratings are not CBBD adjusted ratings or authenticated pretip archives; season-specific Division I membership and data-release timing are unverified.
Two-day calendar lag, fixed prespecified shrinkage and prior non-neutral HCA are research assumptions; no historical result or production promotion claimed before execution.
Historical calibration uses public reconstructed raw-rating forecasts, not original CBBD adjusted ratings or archived odds; total thresholds are model-derived half-integers, not actual contracts.
Holdout is not untouched by earlier scoring research; zero-location comparison prespecified, prior-mean shift separate sensitivity. Week-block CIs descriptive; no distribution promotion.

Sidecar is opt-in, captures local receipt clocks only, may observe a repeat diagnostic parent, not evidence of first ledger freeze; no production pricing changes. Live hosted execution and grading not yet demonstrated.

Complete-box historical sample is not an untouched holdout; probability bins measure moneyline winner confidence, not EV star ratings. No first-half, integer-push or true market-contract calibration is established.
Additional historical self-tests and sidecar-contract tests are specified in the dedicated workflow; the manifest command identifies the core regression suite.
